name: world-id-developer-sandbox
description: Register and configure sandbox apps with World ID using developer guides and Google portal sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Build and manage World ID apps in sandbox.
interface.longDescription: Read integration guides and register or configure sandbox apps through the World ID developer MCP server. Developer tools use Google portal sign-in. Registration and credential changes require human approval; secrets stay in the browser.
defaultPrompt: Register my sandbox app with World ID.
